name: Nell

experience.motif: Victorian botanical illustrations and silver ink particles on deep indigo parchment. Font stack: Cormorant Garamond for headers, clean monospace for technical metrics.

eyebrow: A Sovereign Education for the Next Generation
headline: The living book that grows with your child.
subheadline: An adaptive, lifelong AI tutor inspired by the Illustrated Primer. On the left, a timeless, leather-bound e-paper book; on the right, an evolving digital mind that teaches reading, reasoning, and wisdom through a bespoke, tactile medium.

googleCapabilities.label: Socratic Narrative Engine
googleCapabilities.rationale: Generates personalized, Socratic dialogues and moral tales that adapt dynamically to the child's current learning level and real-world experiences.

config.assistantRole: A wise, patient, and enchanting Socratic tutor inspired by the Illustrated Primer, teaching children logic, reading, and ethics through personalized stories.
config.speechPrompt: Recite the Socratic dialogue in a warm, wise, and patient tone

screens.label: The Living Book
screens.title: Socratic Dialogue & Story
screens.description: Engage with Nell. The story adapts in real-time to your child's responses, weaving in math, logic, and classical ethics.

items.title: The Tale of the Golden Spiral
items.detail: Nell: 'Look closely at the nautilus shell, Elizabeth. Do you see how each chamber grows, yet keeps the exact same shape as the last? Why do you think nature builds this way?'

items.title: The Merchant's Scales
items.detail: An interactive fable teaching basic division and the ethics of fair trade.

screens.label: The Mind Archive
screens.title: Cognitive Development Ledger
screens.description: A local-first, multi-year memory archive mapping your child's intellectual breakthroughs, vocabulary expansion, and conceptual milestones.

items.title: Breakthrough: Geometric Proportions
items.detail: Elizabeth independently deduced the relationship between the radius and circumference during the 'Sailing the Aegean' narrative.

items.title: Moral Inquiry: The Ring of Gyges
items.detail: Explored the concept of invisible actions and personal integrity. Elizabeth concluded that true honor exists when no one is watching.

items.title: Vocabulary Acquisition: 'Sovereign'
items.detail: Successfully integrated 'sovereign' into her spoken dialogue during the constitutional roleplay.

screens.label: Curate Lesson Arc
screens.title: Inject Real-World Context
screens.description: As a parent, guide Nell's narrative engine by inputting upcoming family events, moral challenges, or specific academic focuses.

items.title: Active Override: Sharing with Sibling
items.detail: Weaving sibling cooperation themes into the upcoming 'The Ant and the Chrysalis' fable.

items.title: Upcoming Chapter: The Socratic Beehive
items.detail: Introduces division of labor and community ethics through a botanical allegory.

workflow.title: Configure Next Narrative Arc
workflow.description: Direct Nell's Socratic focus for the coming week. The AI will seamlessly weave these themes into your child's daily stories.

fields.label: Real-World Context or Event
fields.placeholder: e.g., Visiting grandfather's farm, learning to share with younger brother

fields.label: Core Virtue to Emphasize
options: Fortitude (Courage in the face of difficulty)

workflow.successMessage: Nell's local memory has been updated. The next chapter will gently introduce these concepts through an enchanting botanical allegory.
